identity.name: U.S. Reports volumes 300–399 — Caselaw Access Project — 1910–1970 (part-0001)
identity.description: 61926 historical CAP case records, selected by selected reporter volumes. This bounded historical reporter collection contains the earlier 347–349 pilot in full; installing both duplicates those records. It is not the complete U.S. Reports or federal collection. OCR may contain errors; inclusion does not establish current legal authority.
